crossRefs.note: The prophet took up the body of the man of God, and laid it on the donkey, and brought it back. He came to the city of…
He laid his body in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, “Alas, my brother!”
They buried him in David’s city among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, and toward God and his house.
His disciples came, and took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.
When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea, named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple came.
Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.

parallels.note: His disciples came, and took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.

translations.web: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
translations.bsb: When John’s disciples heard about this, they came and took his body and placed it in a tomb.
translations.kjv: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
translations.asv: And when his disciples heard thereof, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
